body: Agentic workloads resend long contexts that barely change between calls. Prefix caching now skips most of their prefill, yet every request must still be tokenized in full before the cache can even be consulted. Tokenization, a CPU stage long treated as negligible, becomes the largest part of time-to-first-token (TTFT), and a frontend that tokenizes for a whole GPU fleet limits how many GPUs it can feed. We present GraphTok, a GPU tokenizer that runs the entire encoding pipeline, from pre-tokenization through byte-pair encoding (BPE) merging to token-ID assembly, as one replayable CUDA graph. GraphTok reproduces the reference token IDs bit-for-bit on GPT-2, Llama 3, Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek-V3, and Gemma 3, hands short inputs to a CPU engine where the GPU cannot win, and plugs into unmodified vLLM and NVIDIA Dynamo. GraphTok encodes one million GPT-2 tokens in 1.7-3.2 ms including data transfers, and on Llama 3 it is 4.7-6.0x faster than gigatoken, the strongest CPU tokenizer. On TokTier's own single-request benchmark, it is 2.6-3.9x faster than gigatoken and up to 18.1x faster than TokTier. In vLLM with a cached prefix, it lowers mean TTFT by 2.1-2.4x. The largest gain is capacity. Within a 2 s P99 target, one Dynamo frontend with GraphTok sustains 518 requests/s of 121k-token traffic, the busiest-hour load of 56 GPUs, against 296 with gigatoken and 18.5 with the default tokenizer. Across 121k to one million tokens, this is 1.75-2.5x the load gigatoken sustains, with a P99 up to 64x lower where gigatoken's tail breaks.
summaryZh: GraphTok 提出了一种将 Tokenization 过程从 CPU 迁移至 GPU 的创新方案，通过将预处理、BPE 合并及 Token-ID 组装封装为 CUDA Graph，解决了 Agentic 工作负载中 Tokenization 成为首字延迟（TTFT）瓶颈的问题。该方法在 Llama 3 等主流模型上实现了 4.7-6.0 倍的加速，并在 vLLM 框架中将 TTFT 降低了 2.1-2.4 倍。在实际部署中，GraphTok 显著提升了 GPU 集群的请求处理容量，在 2 秒 P99 延迟目标下，单前端处理能力提升至 518 请求/秒，为高并发 Agent 应用提供了高效的推理基础设施优化路径。

glossary.explanationZh: 将文本转换为模型可处理的 Token ID 序列的过程。
Time-to-First-Token，即首字生成延迟，是衡量推理响应速度的关键指标。
Byte-Pair Encoding，一种常用的子词分词算法。
一种将一系列 CUDA 操作封装为单一执行单元的技术，可减少 CPU 开销。
一种高性能的大模型推理与服务框架。
